blocks.text: FAQs – Tire Removal

items.q: Do you remove all types of tires, including car and truck tires?
a: Yes! We remove all tire types, passenger cars, SUVs, trucks, ATVs, farm equipment, and more. No job is too big, from single tire pickups to commercial fleet removals. All sizes and conditions accepted.

items.q: How do you dispose of old tires?
a: We partner with certified recycling facilities that shred tires for repurposing into playground surfaces, rubberized asphalt, and other products. Functional tires get donated to community projects. Nothing goes to landfills.

items.q: How much does tire removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125 per tire with volume discounts available. Get a free instant quote online or by phone. Our transparent pricing includes pickup, hauling, and eco-friendly disposal with no hidden fees.

items.q: What areas do you serve for tire removal?
a: We service GTA and surrounding areas. Contact us with your location for confirmation.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day tire pickup?
a: Absolutely! Same-day service is available for urgent requests, subject to availability. Most clients get next-day pickup when booking before noon. Emergency storm cleanups are prioritized.

items.q: Do you recycle or repurpose used tires?
a: 90%+ get recycled through certified processors. Usable tires go to urban farms, playgrounds, and nonprofits. We provide recycling certificates for commercial clients upon request.

items.q: Is there a limit to how many tires I can dispose of at once?
a: No limits! We handle everything from single tires to 1000+ tire cleanouts. Large commercial jobs receive dedicated dumpsters and scheduled pickups.

items.q: Do I need to remove rims before tire removal?
a: Not required! We provide free rim removal (steel/alloy). However, tires without rims qualify for discounted rates. Our team brings professional demounting tools to every job.
